items.title: Franklin Resources (BEN) Is Becoming Franklin Templeton After A Bylaws Change
items.summary: Franklin Resources, trading as NYSE:BEN, is changing its corporate name to Franklin Templeton. The company has amended its bylaws to reflect the new identity. The move aligns the corporate entity with the Franklin Templeton brand used across its global asset management business. Franklin Resources operates as a global asset management company under the Franklin Templeton brand, serving a wide base of institutional and retail clients.
